criteria_verification.notes: TestConcurrentCreate.test_parallel_create_one_succeeds_one_raises_duplicate uses threading.Barrier for genuine contention. Evidence confirms exactly one creation succeeds, loser gets RunbookDuplicateError, final runbook has all 3 steps with no orphaned rows.

TestConcurrentAdvanceAndUpdate.test_advance_and_update_both_succeed synchronizes advance() and update_step_status(0, passed) with threading.Barrier. Evidence confirms both writes committed: current_step_index==1 and steps[0].status==passed.

TestReadOnlySnapshot.test_reader_observes_atomic_transitions synchronizes writer and read_only_connect reader. Evidence confirms reader observes either None (pre-commit) or complete StepResult (post-commit), never partial data. WAL snapshot isolation verified.

TestStoreUnavailable covers both connect_writer (nonexistent parent directory) and read_only_connect (missing file) scenarios. Evidence confirms both raise SQLiteConnectError with domain-shaped error wrapping, no raw backend leak.

TestReadOnlyRefusesWrite.test_create_runbook_on_readonly_connection_refused verifies create_runbook raises sqlite3.OperationalError on read-only connection. Evidence confirms runbook does not exist after failed attempt, proving no write occurred.

TestUnmigratedStoreRejected tests both load_runbook and create_runbook against unmigrated store (only lifecycle_migrations applied, runbook_migration intentionally skipped). Evidence confirms both raise sqlite3.OperationalError mentioning 'runbooks' table.

Evidence confirms all 8 tests in tests/forge/persistence/test_runbook_concurrency.py across 6 test classes (TestConcurrentCreate, TestConcurrentAdvanceAndUpdate, TestReadOnlySnapshot, TestStoreUnavailable, TestReadOnlyRefusesWrite, TestUnmigratedStoreRejected). 5 consecutive runs all passed in 0.06-0.07s with no timing flakiness.

rationale: All 7 acceptance criteria verified against independent evidence from the deterministic bundle. The implementation demonstrates proper concurrency control (threading.Barrier for genuine race conditions), comprehensive integration boundary testing (connection failures, read-only enforcement, migration state), snapshot isolation under WAL mode, and reliable execution (5 consecutive runs, zero flakiness). All quality gates passed, honesty verification clean, no absence-of-failure guards triggered.
